hooks.name: before-reading-queue-task
hooks.description: Re-read the cited acceptance criteria before a spec task runs.

action.prompt: Before this task, open the _Requirements_ ids on the task and the matching criteria in requirements.md or bugfix.md. Do not start a different task.

hooks.name: after-reading-queue-task
hooks.description: Compare the edit with the task criteria after the task finishes.

action.prompt: List each requirement id for the task you just finished and say whether the code satisfies it. Do not check the box for a criterion that is still missing. Stop.
